item.title: India’s first high-altitude wildlife safari to come up in Ladakh
item.summary: Ladakh administration approved India's first high-altitude wildlife safari to prevent illegal off-roading. This initiative aims to protect snow leopards and bird-watching trails in the region. Guided jeep safaris will be introduced on popular tourist routes across the Union Territory. Local youths will be trained as guides for spotting wildlife and birds. The program promotes community-led conservation and responsible eco-tourism.
